content.comment_body: The message means you should start [product_name] as an administrator (with administrator privileges for the operating system).
Those two letters (OS) solved the problem. It didn't occur to me earlier. Thanks!

When I try to create a new folder containing images, I receive the message: 'Operation failed, maybe access denied, please run this application as an administrator and try again.' The web server of [product_name] is working fine for both functions – customizing the site and the panel. However, switching to admin mode from the panel menu didn't resolve the problem. If anyone could provide assistance, it would be greatly appreciated.
